_comment: EXAMPLE per-device travel-router identity for modem-tune. The engine ships this generic template; real device identity is private DATA at <data-root>/config/modem.json. Each device: transport (gl_modem|ubus), host (the device's LAN IP -- used as the SSH target so routers on different subnets resolve per-device; MODEM_HOST in .env is the fallback when a device has no host), tac (8-digit device-class code), factory_imei (original 15-digit IMEI, the revert target).
